name: JW Marriott San Francisco Union Square
positioning: Downtown San Francisco hotel at Post and Mason, a couple of blocks from Union Square, with a soaring atrium lobby and Golden Gate View Rooms
best_for: Travelers who want a base a couple of blocks from Union Square shopping
Guests traveling with their dog or other four-legged friends

facts.text: The hotel is located just moments from Union Square.
The hotel sits at Post and Mason, a couple of blocks from the shopping of Union Square.
The location gives easy access to Oracle Park for baseball games and Chase Center for basketball and concerts.
Cylindrical glass elevators run between the floors.
Beds have pillowtop bedding with deluxe linens.
All rooms and suites include Illy coffee makers and 55-inch streaming TVs.
Level III Restaurant serves classics and modern American cuisine built on locally sourced Bay Area produce.
Level III Bar serves handcrafted cocktails, light bites and Northern California wines.
The fitness center has wood floors and big windows that let light stream in.
The hotel encourages guests to bring their four-legged friends.
The JW Market convenience store stocks snacks, beverages and travel essentials for hotel guests.
Guests can pre-order in-room amenities such as sweet treats and wines to enhance a stay.

highlights.text: Golden Gate View Rooms look out to the Golden Gate Bridge and the surrounding San Francisco skyline.
The lobby has a large sculpture of people dancing at the center of its inlaid stone floor.
The lobby opens up to a soaring atrium.
The California Presidential Suite is the hotel's top accommodation, with room to entertain and lounge.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with separate bathtubs and spacious countertops.

considerations.text: The hotel is very close to the Tenderloin neighborhood.
With ample event space, the hotel attracts a strong following of business travelers.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
